name: Authority / Token / attenuate / authorize

test_list.description: A real signed descendant with a type-invalid expression and an unrepresentable TTL reject as input failures, not component-fatal errors.
Kani: every i64 issue time and u128 lifetime rejects zero/overflow and otherwise preserves the exact sum.
A signed root missing the supported vocabulary cannot be repaired by an appended version/grant fact.
A valid signed descendant with a transitive-closure fact explosion hits evaluator limits and never grants.
Changing a valid descendant's delegation proof fails signature verification.
Issue a real Ed25519 Biscuit, serialize/reparse it and authorize its scope.
A token from another authority fails signature verification.
Debug output contains no key/token material.
Each ungranted right is denied by the authority-origin policy.
An exact path or directory scope cannot authorize a sibling prefix.
Symbol capabilities require both typed path and symbol facts.
Reject traversal, absolute/drive/UNC paths, ADS, reserved names, ambiguous suffixes and encoded separators.
No fixed epoch; reject at expiry and before issuance.
Check actual churn, unsafe changes and exact patch hash, including missing hashes.
Wider child path/churn/TTL/unsafe/rights/hash constraints do not erase ancestor checks.
Each level adds signed restrictions without the root private key.
Adversarial appended facts cannot satisfy ancestor mutation checks or authority grants.
Optional external revocation IDs apply to every signature in the chain.
Oversized tokens and overlong chains are refused.
Reject zero/sub-microsecond lifetime and overflowing expiration.
Generated child constraints never add authorization beyond their parent.
Arbitrary byte strings reject without granting or panicking.

inputs.name: facts
inputs.description: Trusted workspace path, actual mutation metrics, requested right, and injected clock.

output_description: Default-deny authorization with signed attenuation and explicit evaluation bounds.
